title: rosa hispanica f. pouzinii
intro: Rosa hispanica f. pouzinii, commonly known as the Spanish rose, is a plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa hispanica f. pouzinii include reducing pain, inflammation, and stress, as well as promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat various health conditions such as wounds, fever, and digestive issues.
